notes: City of Agoura Hills pre-approved ADU, Plan 1 'Cottage' — a single detached dwelling unit with no repetition, so the extraction's REPEATED UNITS rule must not scale anything here. Truth is transcribed from sheet S1-201 'Foundation & Roof Framing Plans — Cottage & Ranch', read as a rendered image: the CONTINUOUS FOOTING, GRADE BEAM, PAD FOOTING and SHEARWALL HOLDOWN schedules, the ROOF BEAM / FLOOR RAFTER / HEADER schedules, and the slab-on-grade plan callout. Sizes and reinforcing come from those schedules verbatim; counts and lengths do not appear anywhere on the sheet, so every quantity is null rather than derived off the 1/4"=1'-0" plan. Not enumerated (hence partial): the architectural sheets, the window and door schedules, the general structural notes sheets (S-100 to S-103), and the typical concrete/wood detail sheets (S-301, S-401 to S-404). TRAP WORTH KNOWING, deliberately NOT put in `forbidden` because it is unverified: the PREFABRICATED ROOF TRUSS schedule on this sheet lists thirteen truss types (RT, SGT, MT, JT, VJT, CJT, GT, MGT, DT, CGT, HR, CHT, SCT) as a standard type key, and this small cottage plainly does not use all thirteen — an extraction that emits every row is over-reading a legend, but confirming which types the plan actually tags requires a careful pass over the roof framing plan that has not been done. The same S1-201 sheet serves both the Cottage and the Ranch plan.
